messages.author: d1088a2d61a56b06
messages.subject: Table with multiple pages
parts:
Hi,

I am quite new to knitr, and I'm having difficulty producing a table that spans over multiple pages.  Which is to say, I've only managed to produce tables of one page, so far.   What are the options recommended to produce a multipage table?

Thanks much
Thomas Grzybowski

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Table with multiple pages
parts:
You can use the longtable package. The xtable supports it.

You can also use the function kable() in the development version of
knitr (https://github.com/yihui/knitr#readme), and an example is
https://github.com/yihui/knitr-examples/blob/master/091-knitr-table.Rnw

Regards,
Yihui
--
